title: Under The Shack
description:
THE STORY

When a young girl is caught alone in a violent storm, she takes shelter in an old shack on the outskirts of town. But safety is the last thing she finds.

Beneath the floorboards lies a hidden research facility owned by Parasol Nerv Inc., a corporation whose experiments birthed the deadly Wraith Virus. Trapped underground, she must escape a deranged doctor, uncover the truth about her past, and fight her way back to her family.

But survival comes with a price.

When she reunites with her mother, a devastating secret is revealed: She and her sister were born in that lab. They were never meant to escape.

Before the girls can process the truth, the doctor returns — and their mother is killed. Forced to flee into the infected city, the sisters join forces with Freyja’s husband, one of the last scientists who can stop the virus.

Their mission: Launch a cure into the atmosphere that will trigger a permanent winter, halting the spread of the Wraith Virus forever.

But the cure has consequences. The cold stops the infection… and evolves the monsters already roaming the streets.

The world is saved — but changed forever.
